```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    VIRTUE ETHICS FRAMEWORK                            |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                       |
|  CORE QUESTION: Not "What should I DO?" but "What kind of person     |
|  should I BE?" -- Character is primary; rules are derivative.        |
|                                                                       |
|  ARISTOTLE'S FRAMEWORK:                                               |
|  +------------------+  +------------------+  +------------------+   |
|  | EUDAIMONIA       |  | VIRTUE           |  | PHRONESIS        |   |
|  | The good life    |  | Excellence of    |  | Practical wisdom |   |
|  | Human flourishing|  | character        |  | Knowing how to   |   |
|  | The telos of a   |  | Mean between     |  | apply virtues    |   |
|  | human life       |  | extremes         |  | in context       |   |
|  +------------------+  +------------------+  +------------------+   |
|                                                                       |
|  VIRTUOUS PERSON IS THE STANDARD: "What would a person of good      |
|  character do?" -- not "what does the rule say?"                     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
